rules.rationale: The A13 telephony patch spans phone identity, virtual subscriptions, UICC readiness and subscriber information. Android 16 already contained the current-API ports for IMEI, virtual subscription and UICC behavior, but public subscriber-ID and ICC-serial calls still fell through to real PhoneSubInfo paths. Follow-up b06a887a restores those two final A13 fast paths behind the existing BST telephony gate.
rules.necessity: Required for a coherent virtual SIM identity: applications must observe the same host-provided subscriber and SIM serial values exposed by the rest of the promoted telephony stack.
rules.performance: Each affected call adds one feature-gate branch and either one property read or one existing utility lookup. Normal Android behavior has no additional work when the gate is disabled.
rules.security: The fast paths intentionally bypass normal subscriber-identifier permission checks only when the privileged BlueStacks telephony mode is active, matching A13. The feature gate and backing properties must remain inaccessible to untrusted applications.
validation_evidence: android_x86_64-trunk_staging-eng telephony-common and FrameworksTelephonyTests built successfully in 08:20 with -j8.

Component commit b06a887a526981cbc0b23fd2bf469334df9b9f9d and root commit f5ea05cd7f9bf5d7e2c1744d6b6c3390dec1236d record the omissions. Runtime subscriber and ICC serial checks remain in the final boot gate.
